name: Jellyfin Federation
overview: Allows jellyfin servers to federate with each other
description: This Jellyfin plugin allows multiple Jellyfin servers to federate, sharing media libraries in real-time without syncing or copying files. Media can be streamed from one server to another with live transcoding if necessary.

versions.changelog: Privacy: a friend's home internet address no longer appears in this server's logs or on the status page. Public addresses are shown as a short tag (for example "public #3f9a2c:51876") that stays the same for one address while the server runs, so log lines can still be matched up; private, LAN and Tailscale addresses are shown as before for troubleshooting. Error messages that mention an address are cleaned the same way. Your own server's public address is still shown to you on the Beta tab. Includes everything in 0.0.198.
